summary: Build practical WASH assessment, accountability and planning skills with a five-day foundation course. Explore the curriculum and enrol with TrainingCred.
lede: WASH governance training helps WASH officers, utility supervisors, and public health or facility leads assess service responsibilities, track gaps, and plan improvements. Learners practise reviewing service indicators, mapping accountability, identifying water and sanitation risks, monitoring hygiene services, and turning findings into action plans and reports, with an overview of digital mapping and data workflows.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who coordinate, deliver, monitor or oversee WASH services and need practical methods for connecting service evidence with governance decisions.
prerequisites: Designed for foundation-level learners. No programming is required. Familiarity with a WASH, public health, facility, utility or development-service context will help you apply the exercises.
